observation.evaluation:
Correctness: CORRECT
Safety: SAFE
Issues: Laterality of the pleural effusion cannot be definitively determined from this single left lateral chest radiograph alone; the blunting of the posterior costophrenic angle confirms the presence of a small effusion, but distinguishing right from left requires a frontal view.
Suggestion: Correlate with a frontal (PA/AP) radiograph to confirm the right-sided laterality, as requested in the risk note.
